from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentEvidence(BaseModel):
    """Captures legal facts from a single judgment document needed for cause-of-action classification."""
    document_identifier: str | None = Field(description="The document title or ID mentioned in the text (e.g. '判决文书 1', 'Document 1')")
    explicit_cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The case cause explicitly stated in the text (e.g. '继承纠纷', '行政诉讼')")
    administrative_act_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of administrative act involved (e.g. '工伤认定', '行政许可', '拆迁安置', '不予赔偿')")
    compensation_nature: str | None = Field(description="The nature of compensation claim if applicable (e.g. '非刑事赔偿', '刑事赔偿', '国家赔偿')")
    civil_relationship: str | None = Field(description="The underlying civil relationship if applicable (e.g. '继承', '合同纠纷', '借款')")
    demolition_involvement: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the case involves house demolition or relocation management")
    execution_compensation_claim: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the case involves compensation for wrongful execution")
    citation_to_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Only if it is a paper referencing task")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentEvidence]
